streaming_strategy.fit: CV over (STM, OTM) on full series, pick best.

inv.tier1_core_exception: Single-series forecasting; n<=1e6 typical; CV-selected STM/OTM needs multiple full-series fits. Not a fit-matrix model.
inv.purpose: AutoTheta: CV-selected STM vs OTM. Evaluates 4 candidates (STM/OTM x additive/multiplicative); holdout MASE selection; refits winner on full series. STM = fixed w2=0.5; OTM = weight-optimized (w2, alpha). Additive via STL (y=T+S+R); multiplicative via log-transform + additive STL. Skips multiplicative when y<=0. Never worse than best-of-{STM,OTM} on validation by construction. SOTA-class classical forecaster.
